subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what threshold/latest-message/global-control policy should it use?
rationale: Current main already has adjacent disclosure mechanisms, but the requested inline collapse is a new UX behavior rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
options.body: Implement a small first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold while keeping the active/latest response readable.

options.title: Prefer Existing Side Reader
options.body: Decline inline collapse for now and treat the canvas/sidebar reader as the supported long-message escape hatch.

options.title: Defer To Broader Chat UX
options.body: Keep the issue open until a broader chat readability/accessibility pass chooses all disclosure states together.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
recommendation.body: Implement a small first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold while keeping the active/latest response readable.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent side-reader verification and scope note make this the best available owner for the remaining UX policy decision.
